For the past two years, I’ve been caring for others’ locs, with a special focus on keeping them healthy, beautiful, and thriving. I can’t wait to be part of your loc journey!

Booking Policies

Please review before reserving your appointment.

Deposit & Payment: A $15 non-refundable deposit is required to secure your appointment and will be applied toward your total service cost. The remaining balance is due on the day of your appointment.

Cancellation & Rescheduling: Please provide at least 24 hours’ notice to cancel or reschedule. Cancellations made within 24 hours and no-shows will result in the deposit being forfeited. If The Loc Fairy cancels your appointment, your deposit will be refunded.

Late Arrivals: A 15-minute grace period is allowed. Arrivals more than 15 minutes late may need to be rescheduled, and the deposit may be forfeited.

Extra Guests: Please come alone unless an additional guest has been discussed and approved beforehand.

Hair Preparation & Pricing: Please arrive with your hair clean and fully dry unless otherwise discussed. Services marked “+” may cost more depending on hair length, loc count, style complexity, or added hair.

Respect: Please maintain a respectful, positive environment. Disrespectful behavior may result in the appointment being ended or future services being denied.

By booking, you acknowledge and agree to these policies.
